prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Columbus. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean Columbus, Ohio (the most common), or a different Columbus (GA, IN, MS, etc.)? Also: do you want UV tanning beds or spray/sunless tans? Any budget or convenience preferences?

If you tell me the city and your preference, I can list 4–6 specific salons nearby with addresses/phone numbers and exactly why you should call each one. 

In the meantime, here’s what I recommend asking each salon when you call (so you can compare them quickly):

- Services offered: UV beds (low- or high-pressure), spray/sunless, airbrush, red-light therapy, grooming.
- New-client specials/first-timer pricing and whether they do a free consultation or patch test.
- Technician credentials: certified spray techs or trained staff.
- Equipment details (for UV): bed type, bulb age/replacement schedule, time limits and recommended sessions for your skin type.
- Spray tan solution brand and color options; whether they do a quick fix or full-body misting; can they do custom color matching?
- Sanitation and safety: how they clean booths, goggles, towels, ventilation.
- Skin-sensitivity/medical guidance and whether they require or perform a patch test.
- Pricing structure: single sessions, packages, memberships, hidden fees, cancellation policy.
- Appointment availability vs. walk-in, typical wait times.
- Location, parking, and hours (especially if you need evenings/weekends).
- Aftercare instructions they provide and whether they offer products to buy on-site.

If you confirm the Columbus you mean and whether you want UV vs spray, I’ll compile a short list of specific salons to call with phone numbers and why each one stands out.
